candidate_reports.remark: Rocky Mountain Power reported a power pole snapped by high winds and wires down near Cedar City.

Flash flooding in the Forsyth Burn Scar was reported by the Emergency Manager saying portions of the town of Pine Valley were cut off due to high water over roads_ and the Santa Clara River ran out of its banks.
Zion National Park Ranger reported flooding issues happening in the park with a group of 50 hikers unable to cross a trail due to flooding.
Video showing water and small rocks flowing over the SR190 in Big Cottonwood that led to law enforcement needing to close the mouth of the canyon temporarily.
Gauge on Paria River at Highway 89 increased from 300 CFS to 2225 CFS.
Spotter reported a large amount of pea-sized hail_ followed by a short-lived burst of penny sized hail on the backside. Time is approximate.
